verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented accuracy guarantee, error-reimbursement policy, or audit-support commitment for calculations Kintsugi produced. The closest item is a marketing line about 'real people to support you whenever needed' (kintsugi-docs-15). That is general support, not a commitment to stand behind wrong numbers, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the vendor stands behind its numbers — a documented accuracy guarantee or audit support commitment if a calculation it produced turns out wrong
